scope: read-only production advisory and function catalog observation

advisories.name: rls_enabled_no_policy
advisories.interpretation: Includes private tables; absence of a policy can intentionally deny direct client access. Not an authorization test.

advisories.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
advisories.interpretation: Callable definer functions require individual authorization review; count alone does not prove an exploit.

limits: Point-in-time catalog metadata, not a backup or authorization proof.
Observed hashes must not replace independently reviewed installation guard expectations.
No passwords, tokens, user rows, or signing keys read.
No production SQL, policy, key, or Auth setting changed.
